title: Four independent utils (concurrency-width bed)
prompt:
Build FOUR completely independent TypeScript utility modules in the current directory. They share NO code and NO files with each other — each is its own separate deliverable that can be built fully in parallel:

1. src/slugify.ts + test/slugify.test.ts — `slugify(s: string): string`: lowercase, trim, collapse runs of non-alphanumerics to a single '-', strip leading/trailing '-'.
2. src/fib.ts + test/fib.test.ts — `fib(n: number): number`: the nth Fibonacci number (fib(0)=0, fib(1)=1), iterative, returns 0 for negative n.
3. src/palindrome.ts + test/palindrome.test.ts — `isPalindrome(s: string): boolean`: true if s reads the same forwards/backwards ignoring case and non-alphanumerics.
4. src/rgbhex.ts + test/rgbhex.test.ts — `rgbToHex(r: number, g: number, b: number): string`: returns '#rrggbb' lowercase, clamping each channel to 0..255.

Each module has node:test tests. Decompose this into FOUR independent cards (one per module) that can be worked concurrently — they touch disjoint files. Run each module's tests with `node --test` (this Node runs .ts natively; do NOT use npx or install anything; the sandbox has no network).

Acceptance command: node --test test/slugify.test.ts test/fib.test.ts test/palindrome.test.ts test/rgbhex.test.ts
specification: Four disjoint utility modules, one card each, buildable in parallel. Acceptance: node --test over all four test files.
